title: Reading context migration drops existing generated context data
reasoning: The migration removes Reading.context, context_last_generated, context_thumbs_down, and context_thumbs_up, then creates the replacement ReadingContext model without copying the existing per-reading values into that new table. Any environment that has rows populated after migration 0027 will lose that generated text, timestamps, and vote counts when applying 0028.
recommendation: Add a RunPython data migration before removing the Reading fields that creates ReadingContext rows from non-empty existing Reading context data and carries over thumbs_up, thumbs_down, and context_last_generated where possible. Remove the old fields only after the copy step.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for migration data preservation, and schema-only migration tests would not catch loss of populated field values.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a migration test that migrates to 0027, creates a Reading with context text, timestamp, and vote counts, migrates to 0028, and asserts a related ReadingContext row preserves those values.
minimumFixScope: Update migration 0028 to include a reversible or at least forward RunPython data copy before the RemoveField operations.
